question: If in a code language, TAP is written as UUQ and BEEP is written as CAAQ, then how will LOW be written in the same language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

**The logic followed here is,**

 
• **The consonants are coded as +1 alphabet.**
 
• **The vowels are coded as the previous vowel.**
 
• A → E → I → O </
